@@note: Machine translation, not yet reviewed by a native French speaker. Made from the mobile app's French (mstream_music, lib/l10n/app_fr.arb, master at bdb174e, GPL-3.0) and the terminal player's (mstream-terminal-player, locales/fr.yml, main at b89ad0a, GPL-3.0) wherever they had the text or its words (vous, « morceau » for a track, « file » for the queue, « casque », « carte SD », « calibrage tactile », « Minuterie de veille », « Aléatoire »), and translated by a Fable agent (Claude) for the rest, then reviewed by a second Fable agent (meaning, terms, grammar, typography), fitted to the rooms with the width checker. Paths (/music/Artist/Album/) and format names stay as they are. The rooms the notes give are those the texts were fitted to (42356b7); the layout fixes since gave most buttons and pills 2-4 px more and Small when their font doesn't fit, so a few of the apps' words a note set aside would fit now (docs/I18N.md, phase 3, lists them for a native review). The Auto DJ texts (October 2026, the engine's UI: toast.autodj_*, now_playing.autodj*, library.autodj_here, empty.autodj, output.autodj*, autodj.*) were made the same way: the mobile app's words for Auto DJ, Ancre, Suivre l'ambiance, titre de départ, Seuil de similarité, Continuité du BPM and Mixage harmonique (its autoDj* keys), translated by a Fable agent otherwise, fitted to en.json's rooms (the notes say where a room made a text shorter), not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
